summary: Executed the phone-landscape (844x390), desktop (1280x800), and portrait (390x844) suite requested for the JMA 'phone landscape only' fixes. Jukebox, Detective, Campus, Jam Session title/guitar/xylophone, desktop and portrait checks all PASS. ONE critical bug remains in Fun Facts (phone landscape + coarse pointer): the `.funfacts-scroller-pad` is `box-sizing: border-box` so its 30vw right-padding is clipped by the scroller's clientWidth, so Stew and Lou cannot be brought within 120px of the porthole centre (Stew residual 283px, Lou residual 163px). Minor: Free Play phone landscape has 8px document scroll vs spec's <=5px threshold; Robot Boogie reports data-scale=1.00 (content fits naturally at 390px, inner overflow=0) which is below spec's expected 0.40-0.60 band but is not a visual defect.

ui_bugs.issue: On phone landscape with coarse pointer the pad has box-sizing:border-box and width:auto (=scroller clientWidth 800px), so the right-side 30vw padding (253px) is absorbed inside the box and does NOT extend the scrollable range. Measured: scrollerScrollWidth=1753 but scene width=1500 + 2x253 padding should yield 2006. Result: funfacts-character-stew unreachable (residual 283px from porthole centre, needs <=120); funfacts-character-lou also unreachable (residual 163px). Vertical padding works because the scene height (~844) is less than the pad content height. Fix: add `.funfacts-scroller-pad{ box-sizing: content-box; width: max-content; }` (or set the pad to inline-block + fit-content) so BOTH sides of padding actually enlarge the scroll range.
At 844x390 the document scrollHeight is 398 vs innerHeight 390 (8px overflow). Spec allows <=5. Mostly cosmetic (no visible scrollbar) but same measurement in Jelly Bells tab also 398.

Measured data-scale=1.00 with inner.scrollHeight - clientHeight = 0 at 844x390 (page naturally fits). Spec expected 0.40-0.60 band. Not a visual defect but FitStage's MIN_BY_ROUTE floor of 0.4 is never engaged on this viewport because scrollHeight<=innerHeight. If the intent is to force shrink, the natural content needs to exceed 390 first. No action required unless target was to make it visually smaller.

action_items: Fix .funfacts-scroller-pad so BOTH left and right 30vw padding actually widen the scroll range on phone landscape coarse pointer (use box-sizing:content-box and/or width:max-content / display:inline-block). Verified Stew residual=283px, Lou residual=163px right now; both must drop to <=120. Vertical padding already works.
Shave 3-8px off .jam-main / free-play layout so document scrollHeight <= 390 at 844x390 (currently 398).
critical_code_review_comments: FunFactsPage.js wraps the fixed-width (w-[2400px] -> 1500px via CSS override) scene inside .funfacts-scroller-pad. With Tailwind's base `*{box-sizing:border-box}` the pad computes to parent width (800px) and the padding is absorbed, defeating the 'padded wrapper so every corner can reach the porthole centre' guarantee claimed in the implementation notes.

FitStage data-scale remains 1 on Robot Boogie at 844x390 because the robot room naturally fits; the comment 'Robot Boogie may shrink more (floor 0.4)' only applies if its natural height exceeds innerHeight. Consider adding a hard scale cap OR verifying content height before shipping.

FunFactsPage .funfacts-scene keeps class `w-[2400px]` even in phone landscape; CSS media-query overrides the computed width to 1500px (`.funfacts-scene.w-\[2400px\]{width:1500px!important}`). This dual-source-of-truth is fragile—consider toggling the class in JS when !desk && !allFound && isPhoneLandscape.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (10/12 phone-landscape checks pass; 1 critical + 2 minor failing; desktop + portrait fully pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reach-computation JS stored inline in prior script: scroller.clientW/H center minus clamped scrollLeft/Top; residual Hypot must be <=120 for each [data-testid^='funfacts-character-']. Phone-landscape 844x390 with matchMedia '(pointer: coarse)' stub mandatory to hit the coarse branch (desk=false). The scroller is data-testid='funfacts-scene-scroller' (class is the SAME string but prefer the data-testid). Stew is positioned at scene far-right and Lou at the bottom-right; vertical pad currently works, horizontal pad does not. Jukebox gameplay only renders .rhythm-lane after clicking a song card (I used data-testid='song-jma_play_one_skip_one'). On Robot Boogie, members are data-testid='robot-boogie-char-<id>' (hits are suffixed `-hit-`).
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE for Stew-unreachable: `.funfacts-scroller-pad { padding: 26vh 30vw; }` is applied to a block element inside the scroller. Tailwind's preflight sets `*{box-sizing:border-box}` globally, so the pad's computed width equals the scroller's clientWidth (800px at 844-ingress-44). Because the padding is inside the border-box, the inner fixed-width scene (1500px) overflows horizontally and the right-side 253px padding is never materialised as scrollable area. scrollWidth=1753 = 1500 + ~left padding only. REPRO: 844x390 viewport, matchMedia '(pointer: coarse)' true, visit /#/fun-facts, allFound=false; compute desired scrollLeft to centre funfacts-character-stew → desired exceeds (scrollWidth-clientWidth)=953 by 283px. MITIGATION: `.funfacts-scroller-pad { box-sizing: content-box; width: max-content; }` OR `display: inline-block` so the pad grows to scene+padding (2006px) and scrollWidth matches.
